svg.title: Label-preserving augmentation depends on the target
svg.desc: An 8 by 8 right arrow is horizontally flipped into a left arrow. Both contain an arrow, but direction changes. Twelve pixel values change and 26 remain foreground. Four flip settings create two unique images because the source is vertically symmetric.
